snippet.title: Static Dread. Release on August 6.
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3298940/Static_Dread_15_Nights_at_the_Old_Lighthouse/

A new Lovecraftian horror — it’s like Papers, Please, but set at sea during the awakening of Cthulhu. 
Dive into a haunting atmosphere, deep story, and mysterious characters.
Release date: August 7, 2025.
Add it to your wishlist on Steam!
